title: Enforce paged evidence disclosure and keep recovery migration fixtures within Windows path limits
outcome: Refuse every restricted native evidence page and exercise migration-based origin recovery in supported Windows fixture layouts.
acceptance: A native capture exported one record per pack refuses a task-revision-only page after the current task becomes restricted; captured restrictions are also enforced independently of companion records, while permitted original IDs and canonical bytes stay unchanged.

The origin-recovery MigrationImport fixture uses a short owned migration output followed by a coherent backup or equivalent supported layout, and actually exercises recovery on Windows without weakening production path guards.
Focused behavioral checks cover the new disclosure refusal and actual migration/recovery path; exact patch/base/tree and results are recorded for parent integration.

completion.summary: Enforce current and captured task restrictions on every native evidence page, and exercise migration-based origin recovery using a short import path followed by a coherent backup.
